name: Fun.xyz retired CheckoutPool unauthenticated bridge()
summary: A retired CheckoutPool's bridge() had no caller check and setAllowAll(true) had lifted its target allowlist, yet it stayed a CheckoutPaymaster operator. The attacker registered a checkout with an inflated targetAmount through the live pool's permissionless deposit(), then had the paymaster call the live pool's execute(), which paid it from pool excess.
notes: The live pool is a target: its execute() pays whatever targetAmount a permissionless deposit() registered, trusting only its paymaster. setPaymaster pointing it at the paymaster whose retired operator was open is the latest change the exploit needed (rule 8 role grant); before it this pool could not be reached.

The retired pool 0x13046f51 is unverified; its ungated bridge() follows from the runtime (no operator getter) and from the attacker calling it directly. The referenced setup transactions are the attacker's deposit() registrations, whose 1 USDC.e inputs are not netted (rule 11).
Campaign: copycat 0xc513e4f5 repeated the path, draining the live pool and two other paymaster operators (0xed6dbff9, 0xc7044e4a); its probe 0x1eb47582 moved nothing and is omitted.
